The first release candidate of visual[flow] 1.0: a MilkDrop player for the Mac. Open it, let it hear your music, and pick something to play.

**For testers.** Download the disk image below (Apple silicon, macOS 14.4 or later to hear a DAW directly) and drag visual[flow] to Applications. A candidate follows the release channel, so it updates to 1.0.0 when that's out. Report what you find as [an issue](https://github.com/openflowfm/visuals/issues/new).

## What's in 1.0

- **Hear your music:** listen straight to Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Bitwig Studio or any other music app, to everything on the Mac, or to a mic or interface, with no driver or loopback device. A second input can be mixed in alongside the main one.
- **Presets:** 250 MilkDrop presets from projectM's Cream of the Crop come with the app. The full pack (9,795 presets) is one download of about 53 MB, and it carries on downloading while you play.
- **Library:** thumbnails, automatic groups (style, author, colour, brightness, speed, intensity), a library map, stars, your own tags, hiding presets, and each preset's own speed and sensitivity.
- **Playlists are home.** Each playlist carries its own settings, and smart playlists fill themselves.
- **Live mode:** plays in the window or full screen on the display you pick. It has performance effects (strobe, blackout, punch, freeze, mirror, speed, trails and more) on keys, a crate, and Stay on this one to hold a preset. Hold Esc to leave.
- **Ableton Link:** follows your session's tempo and bars and changes presets on the bar line. Bars count from the one, which you can set and nudge. It never sets the tempo.
- **Camera:** feed your outline into the playing preset, processed on your Mac.
- **Output:** pick the resolution, scale and frame rate. A quality setting keeps base Macs smooth.
- **Settings that stay:** the audio source, output display, tempo, effects, brightness and whether Link is on are all kept for the next launch.
- **Accessibility:** VoiceOver labels, Reduce motion (the strobe pulses softly and flashes come at most twice a second), Reduce transparency, and a photosensitivity warning before the first show.
- **Privacy:** no telemetry and no server. Crash reports are off by default, written on your Mac, and only sent if you send them yourself.
- **Updates:** it checks on launch and installs only when you say so. Choose the release channel or the latest build from `main` in Settings.

visual[flow] 1.0 is dark only. An Appearance setting comes in 1.1, and MIDI comes first after 1.0.

Thanks to projectM, ISOSCELES and every preset author.
